label: CCR2116-12G-4S+
description: 1 RU cloud core router built on a 16-core 2 GHz ARM64 CPU with 16 GB RAM: twelve 1G RJ-45 ports and four 10G SFP+ cages, all wired through the Marvell Aldrin switch chip, plus an M.2 PCIe slot and a serial console. Targets 10G-era BGP and NAT edge roles at a fraction of the cost of a chassis router.
notes: MikroTik product page: "four 10G SFP+ ports ... connected to the Marvell Aldrin family switch chip. Then we have Gigabit Ethernet ports. 12 of them are running through the Marvell chip." Port labels are eth1-eth12 and SFP+1 to SFP+4 on the panel (RouterOS calls them ether1-ether12 and sfp-sfpplus1-4). No PoE, no USB data ports (M.2 PCIe slot and 1x RJ-45 serial console only).
